title: Pure Dream Mirror
summary: Pure Dream Mirror Fusion and tag-out strategy featuring the dual Field Spells Dream Mirror of Joy and Dream Mirror of Terror alongside their LIGHT and DARK counterpart monsters. Guided by Neiroy, the Dream Mirror Traitor, the deck manipulates both Field Spells simultaneously with Dream Mirror Hypnagogia to unlock mirror-tribute swaps, quick destruction, and Fusion bosses Oneiros, the Dream Mirror Erlking and Tormentor.

summary.title: Starters
points: Neiroy, the Dream Mirror Traitor on Normal or Special Summon searches Neiroy, the Dream Mirror Disciple, then tributes a Dream Mirror monster to search a Dream Mirror Field Spell and Special Summon a Dream Mirror monster from the Deck.
Neiroy, the Dream Mirror Disciple Special Summons itself from hand while a Dream Mirror monster is on field, and modulates its Attribute to LIGHT or DARK.
Dream Mirror Phantasms searches any Dream Mirror monster from Deck to hand upon activation, and continuously pumps your monsters or shrinks the opponent's depending on the active Field Spell.
Ikelos, the Dream Mirror Sprite searches any Dream Mirror card from Deck to hand when Special Summoned by the effect of a Dream Mirror monster.

summary.title: Opening: Neiroy, the Dream Mirror Traitor
steps: Normal Summon Neiroy, the Dream Mirror Traitor and activate its effect to search Neiroy, the Dream Mirror Disciple from your Deck.
Special Summon Neiroy, the Dream Mirror Disciple from your hand.
Activate Traitor's effect, tributing Disciple to search Dream Mirror of Joy (or Terror) from your Deck and Special Summon Ikelos, the Dream Mirror Sprite from your Deck.
Trigger Ikelos, the Dream Mirror Sprite on summon to search Dream Mirror Hypnagogia (or Dream Mirror of Chaos) from your Deck.
Activate Dream Mirror of Joy and Set Dream Mirror Hypnagogia to place both Joy and Terror onto the field on the opponent's turn, making all mirror swaps live.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Oneiros, the Dream Mirror Tormentor is a Level 10 Fusion that Quick Effect negates any monster effect activation while Dream Mirror of Terror is active, and tributes itself under Joy to summon Oneiros, the Dream Mirror Erlking.

Oneiros, the Dream Mirror Erlking destroys 1 card on the field whenever another monster you control is tributed while Dream Mirror of Joy is active, and tributes itself under Terror to summon Tormentor.
Morpheus, the Dream Mirror Black Knight destroys 1 card on the field when Special Summoned by a Dream Mirror monster's effect.
Phantasos, the Dream Mirror Friend targets and Special Summons a Level 8 or lower Dream Mirror monster from your GY when Special Summoned by a Dream Mirror card.

Every main deck Dream Mirror monster tributes itself as a Quick Effect during either player's turn to Special Summon its opposite-Attribute counterpart directly from the Deck while the corresponding Field Spell is face-up.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Dream Mirror Hypnagogia activates directly from the Deck or hand to place Dream Mirror of Joy in one Field Zone and Dream Mirror of Terror in the other, guaranteeing both mirror effects are active at once.
Dream Mirror of Chaos is a Quick-Play Spell that Fusion Summons a Dream Mirror Fusion Monster using materials from hand or field, and can banish materials from the GY if both Field Spells are active.
Dream Mirror Oneiromancy is a Counter Trap that negates a Spell/Trap card or effect while Dream Mirror of Joy is face-up, or negates a Special Summon while Dream Mirror of Terror is face-up.
Dream Mirror Fantasy recycles one banished Dream Mirror of Joy and one banished Dream Mirror of Terror into the Deck to banish 1 card on the field.
